+## Filters
+
+Append filters to a variable with `|`. They run from left to right:
+
+```text
+{{name | squash | title}}
+{{summary | truncate(40)}}
+```
+
+| Filter          | Effect                                   |
+|-----------------|------------------------------------------|
+| `upper`         | uppercase the value                      |
+| `lower`         | lowercase the value                      |
+| `title`         | `snake_case` to `Title Case`             |
+| `kebab`         | words to `kebab-case`                    |
+| `squash`        | collapse runs of whitespace              |
+| `truncate(n)`   | keep at most `n` characters              |
+
+An unknown filter name fails parsing with `UnknownFilter`.
+
